description: Named benchmark slices for solver measurement. These definitions are intentionally small metadata records; expanded per-level manifests should be emitted as bench-store artifacts when a run is made.

slices.name: smoke-50
slices.purpose: Fast solver change detector for day-to-day work.

selection.stability: Sort corpus game paths lexicographically, hash each relative path with the seed, and take the first 50. Store the expanded manifest path in each bench-store run artifact.

slices.name: sokoban-skew-200
slices.purpose: Medium slice biased toward push/block mechanics where most solver regressions have historically shown up.

selection.stability: Prefer games whose source contains mechanic_hints, then fill from the seeded corpus order. Persist the expanded game/level manifest before running.

slices.name: hard-tail-300
slices.purpose: Slow-tail slice for throughput and search-order experiments that need more signal than the smoke slice.

selection.stability: Rank levels by the latest stored baseline elapsed/generated cost when available, otherwise use the checked-in focus group followed by seeded corpus order. Persist the expanded manifest before running.
